name: PIXIE · The Playing Deck
tagline: Familiar cards. A guardian at the threshold.
description: A standard 52-card pack with two proposed ranked jokers. Heart lanterns, club flowers, repaired diamonds and spade doorways carry PIXIE’s story into familiar table games.
variant: Bridge, Hearts, Spades and Bid Whist are intended uses; final joker ranking and game-specific testing remain open.
art: Existing AI-generated concept studies. Earlier images show a paper book; the intended final object is PIXIE’s sigilled digital codex. A complete 54-face set has not been verified.
botNote: PIXIE is the shared guide character. This card deck has no connected game bot.
imageAlt: Existing PIXIE concept card with six spade doorways and a violet-winged skeletal guardian.

name: PIXIE · The Reflection Deck
description: A tarot-inspired oracle proposal: 22 archetype cards and 32 journey cards, with eight cards for each of four chapters. It is a custom 54-card system, distinct from traditional 78-card tarot.
variant: Awakening, Listening, Repair and Choosing. Short titles, optional prompts and no reversals are the proposed reading structure.
art: Companion visual language exists in the playing-card studies. Completed oracle faces and an approved card-by-card guide are still open.
botNote: PIXIE suggests reflection while leaving interpretation and decisions with the reader. The reflection control here cycles authored prompts locally.
imageAlt: PIXIE deck-back concept with a violet-winged skeletal guardian and ornate book motif.
specimen: Record the observation before the story.
What is yours to offer—and to decline?

name: The Sealed Deck
tagline: Four suits. Four ways to hold power.
description: The 52 Cards of War connects Conquest, Restoration, Intelligence and Fortification with the Death’s Daughter / Veiled Dominion story. Its mixed-pantheon court gives those domains names and histories.
variant: Core mixed-pantheon edition. Sufi Tariqah is a personal-deck interpretation; Kemetic Dynasty, Shinbi Tactics and Fifth Sun are documented cultural reskins.
art: Blackwork and engraved linework with amber accents. The card-reference PDF and full rules text exist; a complete illustrated production deck is not established.
botNote: The Rift is associated with the wider match-to-lore pathway. Sealed Deck narration and a playable deck integration remain proposed.
source: August Court Card Bible; Sealed Deck lore bible; 52-card reference PDF; repository card database.
specimen: The Wild Fate · shared across suits

name: Sufi Tariqah
tagline: The Queen’s path through the court.
description: Rebirth’s personal-deck interpretation in the Dueling Systems design. Its four suit paths explore discipline, gnosis, truth and inner structure through an authored Sufi-inspired framework.
variant: The Queen’s deck is paired narratively with Death’s Systems Quartet. Cross-system arbitration, shared resources and cooperative combinations remain unresolved.
art: Lapis blue, black and amber; geometric illumination and calligraphic suit studies. The brief is an artistic interpretation, not a religious teaching guide. Finished card art was not verified in this scan.
botNote: The Rift’s design spec anticipates Sealed Deck events. No dedicated Sufi-deck bot was verified.
source: The Sealed Deck: The Sufi Tariqah Variant; Dueling Systems handoff.

name: The Kemetic Dynasty
tagline: A court written in lapis and gold.
description: An Ancient Egyptian interpretation of the Sealed Deck’s four domains. Its court is documented suit by suit, from Set and Sekhmet to Ptah, Seshat and Imhotep.
variant: A cultural reskin of the Sealed Deck, with the same four-domain structure. Its character assignments do not create a new current four-player ruleset.
art: Papyrus-inspired composition, hieroglyphic borders, lapis, gold and black are specified. The text preview below represents the documented court; finished illustrations were not verified.
botNote: Related to the shared lore pathway; no dedicated Kemetic bot was found.

name: The Shinbi Tactics
tagline: The court, recast in woodblock ink.
description: A Japanese myth and yōkai interpretation of the Sealed Deck. The design connects each suit’s role to a distinct court, from Susanoo’s Conquest to the foundations of Sarutahiko.
variant: One of three global mythological skins in the lore bible. This edition is distinct from the Paragon character Shinbi’s Moon card.
art: Ukiyo-e-inspired flat color: black, red, ash grey and white. Court names are documented; complete illustrations were not verified.
botNote: No dedicated Shinbi Tactics bot was found. A shared lore connection is a design relationship only.

name: The Fifth Sun
tagline: Obsidian, jade and the architecture of a world.
description: The Sealed Deck’s Mesoamerican interpretation uses an authored court drawn from mythic figures, organized through the same Conquest, Restoration, Intelligence and Fortification domains.
variant: The third global mythological skin. These are the design bible’s assignments and interpretations, rather than claims that the traditions share one system.
art: Angular stone-carved composition, obsidian black, jade green and amber. Complete card illustrations were not verified.
botNote: No dedicated Fifth Sun bot was found; future shared narration is not an implemented service.

name: Violet’s Revenge
tagline: Every card is a case file.
description: A Gothic Forensics edition of the 52 Cards of War. Violet’s supernatural morgue gives the four domains new visual identities: the hunt, the autopsy slab, the investigation and the barricade.
variant: The documented deck is a themed legacy War-card design. The separate asymmetric horror game and current Veiled Dominion rules retain their own authority.
art: Purple, luminol blue and industrial black. Engraved titles, clinical rules text, evidence tags and a slab-and-scalpel back are specified; a full illustrated set was not verified.
botNote: Violet’s legacy Discord bot is retired. An opt-in browser persona and the Violet_88 gamemaster are documented proposals, not services connected here.
source: CARD-DESIGN-GUIDE.md; CARD-TEXT-DATABASE.md; Roomy transition; Violet_88 proposal.

name: Float Cards
description: A simultaneous card duel using a standard 52-card pack without jokers. Each side commits a card; the higher rank wins the round and deals one RP of damage. Ties deal none.
variant: Human versus Pennywise, or Violet-versus-Pennywise exhibition modes are present in the historical bot source. Float Chess is a sibling engine, not the same ruleset.
art: A standard pack is sufficient for the source prototype. A bespoke illustrated Float Cards deck was not found.
botNote: Move selection and persona narration are separate. The October 4 transition records the Discord service at zero running replicas; browser reuse remains proposed.
source: float-cards-engine.js; Discord card commands; Roomy retirement record.

name: Break the Grid
tagline: Change the response. Or change the system.
description: Sixteen neutral cards in four categories: Boundary, Connection, Resource and Voice. Every card offers an immediate response and a collective change, turning shared support into a choice players can make.
variant: A new compact pressure/support module for initial two-player paper tests. It is separate from the archived War Hand and the earlier artist-linked Inpatient concept.
art: The printable review sheet and all sixteen card texts exist. Code, title and category accompany every card so meaning never depends on color alone. Balance values remain provisional.
botNote: No deck-specific bot was verified. A future Duet implementation is proposed; this catalogue does not automate facilitation.

name: Paragon · Return to the Void
tagline: A character’s arc becomes a card.
description: Twenty-two Major Arcana and fifty-six Minor Arcana connect the Return to the Void character framework to upright and reversed readings, visual scenes and branching narrative design.
variant: Swords, Staves, Cups and Coins each have fourteen cards. The older Drive workbook and the repository’s expanded handoff preserve the original character assignments.
art: The repository contains card-by-card illustration briefs and a companion-book artifact. This is a design handoff, not evidence of seventy-eight finished illustrations or a cleared merchandise edition.
botNote: No tarot-reading or deck-play bot was verified. Planned game AI in Paragon-Reborn is separate from this tarot design.
source: Paragon Deck workbook; paragon-tarot-research.md; Deck Design Notes.
